Once all the ingredients are added, you are free to add any more seasoning if you like, such as a bit of salt and pepper, but in my case, I am only using what is mentioned.

Prepare your spatula and mixing bowl and start mixing the ingredients until thoroughly combined. Scrape from the bottom of the bowl to prevent any mess when combining all of them. After mixing, you can immediately use it as a dip since fresh is always the best. You can store the rest in a glass container for later use.

title: Homemade Keto Ranch Dressing Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all of your ingredients. I have replaced the mayo with sour cream to reduce calories. Regarding herbs, it is best if you could use all the fresh ones. Chop all herbs into tiny pieces, press your garlic, squeeze juice from lemon and get 2 cups of sour cream.
Let us start with a big mixing bowl into which you can add all of the sour cream and the juice from freshly squeezed lemon.
As the next step, add all of the herbs one by one, which is, in our case, dill, chives, and parsley. Add freshly pressed garlic cloves.
The last two ingredients are salt and pepper. I only add approximately one teaspoon each as I always like the fresh aroma from the other herbs.
Once all ingredients are in the mixing bowl, take your spatula or a spoon and mix all herbs with the sour cream until all thoroughly combined.

title: Easy Healthy Creamy Salsa Dressing Recipe
instructions: Prepare all the 4 ingredients you need for making this super easy healthy creamy salsa dressing recipe.
At the same time, prepare Magic Bullet or any blender you have available.
One by one, add all the ingredients into the blender.
Blend all ingredients.
Once all is blended, pour into your serving jar or a Mason Jar to store for later.

title: Garden Vegetable Soup
instructions: To make this soup, thoroughly clean and cut your fresh vegetables. Chop into small cubes, which will shorten your cooking time.
Using a large pot on a stove, heat up butter, add onions and chopped garlic, and cook to caramelize. Add the leeks and spring onions and mix. Add the carrots and mix.

Add the zucchini or yellow summer squash, broccoli, green peas or any other vegetables in your garden. Fill up with water, chicken broth or vegetable broth, bring the soup to a boil, and continue to cook for 4 to 5 more minutes.

Add salt and pepper to taste. In the middle, combine your fresh herbs tight together. Cover the soup and bring to a simmer for 15 minutes until your zucchini are tender, stirring occasionally. Once done, remove from heat and serve immediately.

title: Winter Root Vegetable Soup Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients needed. Root vegetables can be any of your choices.
To prepare a homemade whey, follow the steps in the article. You can also buy already-made whey if you like in various supermarkets.
Peel and cut all of the root vegetables together with onions into same–size squares. The smaller squares you have, the less time it will take to cook the soup, and the more probiotics are preserved.
Heat the soup pot or a Dutch oven and place the butter to melt. Once the butter melts, add onions and cook until golden brown.
Once your onions are cooked, add the remaining vegetables, season with salt and pepper, and saute for 4-5 minutes with butter. Roasting all of the veggies adds a great flavor to your soup.

Once all the vegetables are roasted, add protein-enriched whey liquid and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. After it has cooked, reduce heat and bring to a simmer on medium heat for about 15-20 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and easily pierced with a fork.

That is all. Now you can enjoy this easy-to-make winter vegetable soup day after day. Ladle soup into bowls, top each serving with a drizzle of olive oil and sprinkle with chopped rosemary and broccoli sprouts.

title: Low Carb Buns
instructions: Heat up the oven on 150C (302 F)
First of all, prepare all of the dry ingredients, which are almond flour, protein powder, xanthan gum, baking powder, and salt.
In a big bowl, add all of the dry ingredients, and using a whisk, mix them all, making sure the mixture of keto flour is as smooth as possible.
Separate eggs and whisk whites until stiff peaks form. Then placed them aside
Mix Yogurt, oil and water together
Now it’s time to whisk your egg yolks.
Switch your kitchen machine on a medium speed and slowly start adding dry ingredients and yogurt mixture.
Place the dough into the bowl and using a spatula, portion the dough into the same size pieces.
Now it’s time to start shaping the buns. Once you make shapes, place each bun on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
To get a burger like buns I have at the end flattened each bun slightly as you see in the video. You can sprinkle some sesame seeds on top.
Bake in the oven for 35 minutes at 150 Celsius or 300 Fahrenheits.

title: Keto Candied Bacon Twists
instructions: Prepare your bacon - whatever size and thickness you want.
At the same time preheat the oven to 180C or 350F.
Prepare Candied Glaze. Place both sweeteners into the small bowl, where you would be able to mix them together.
Using the brush, mix both together into one thicker consistency.
If you have a wooden board or any other boards, start spreading bacon slices onto it, so they do not touch each other.
Using your brush, brush the mixture onto all of the bacon slices from one side. After you are done, turn all of the slices upside down and brush the other side as well.
Prepare your baking sheet and cover it with Parchment paper.
Start one by one, twisting the bacon using your hand.
Twist from each side in the opposite direction.
Once done, gently place the twisted bacon onto the baking sheet covered with Parchment Paper.
Bake at 180 C or 350 F for approximately 30 minutes, depending on the size and thickness of your bacon.

title: Keto Crispy Twisted Bacon 5 ways
instructions: Prepare your Bacon slices as well as seasonings
If you do not have already grind breadcrumbs, you can simply grind them either in the Magic Bullet or Coffee Grainer.
For dipping, it is best to have shallow containers, that are as long as your bacon is.

If you are not going with any seasoning, take a plain bacon stripe and start twisting it holding each end with your hand. For better understanding, check the video with full step-by-step instructions on how to do twisted bacon.
Place your Pork Rind Breadcrumbs into the longer shaped container and dip the whole bacon slice into it.

Start gently twisting, trying to make sure that you keep as many breadcrumbs on the bacon as possible. If you do have most falling down, just dipped it once again after you have fully twisted the bacon strips.
Place onto the baking sheet covered with parchment paper and continue twisting and dipping.

The exact same steps for Tajin Seasoning as it goes with Pork Rinds Breadcrumbs. Take a stripe of bacon, dip into Tajin Seasoning from both sides and start twisting the bacon. Once fully twisted, place onto the baking sheet and continue.

Sesame Seeds are my third option and actually my preferred one. They stick onto the bacon perfectly. I would say, the best of all of the seasonings I have tried. Once twisted, place onto the baking sheet and continue.
If you have some extra seasoning as well as bacon left, mix all of the seasonings together and follow the same steps as before. Dip the bacon from both sides and twist.
Place all onto the baking sheet and bake for 30-40 minutes (depending on the thickness of your bacon) at 180C or 350 F.
Check after 25 minutes and decide if it needs to be baked much longer or it is almost ready.

title: Rose Powder Recipe
instructions: Prepare your dried petals and prepare your choice of blender or grinder.
Pluck the petals from the small buds; you will only need the petals. Place them in a separate bowl and prepare them for grinding.
Place the dried petals into the magic bullet cup and pulse the blender until they turn into a fine powder. Check if you like the consistency. If it is not powdered enough, add a few more pulses.

title: How To Make Rose Water
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients. For the fresh rose petals, pluck the petals from the roses and clean them gently to remove dirt or bugs. You can also boil the distilled water in advance. At the same time, prepare your ice cubes by placing them in a bowl and the fridge until ready to use.
Place a small heatproof bowl in the center of a larger pot. Surround the bowl with rose petals, ensuring they don't get inside. Gently pour water over the petals.

Cover the pot with an inverted lid so the handle points down into the pot. Let the water simmer, and place 1 cup of ice cubes on the inverted lid. Simmer the pot over low heat for 20-30 minutes. As the ice melts, soak up the water with a dry towel and add more ice as needed. The steam will condense on the underside of the lid and drip into the bowl.

Turn off the heat and carefully remove the lid using pot holders. The liquid collected in the bowl is rose hydrosol or distilled rose water. Use pot holders to remove the bowl and transfer the rose water into a bottle for storage.

title: How To Make Stevia Powder Recipe
instructions: Pick your leaves at the end of the summer, wash and spread them on a paper towel, and let them dry naturally, which takes about three days.
Toss the leaves into the magic bullet blender until you achieve a fine powder.

Let the container sit for a while before opening the blender after powdering, as the powder or residue can settle and escape when you open it and irritate your eyes and nose. Check if all the leaves are powdered.

title: Air Fryer Homemade Pork Rinds Chicharrones
instructions: Prepare your best quality pork skin and salt.

First, make sure the pork skin you bought is of its best quality and fully clean. If it is not clean, wash it properly and dry it with a paper towel. Cut the pork skin into the blocks, fitting into your cooking pot. Place all of the skin inside the cooking pot, add water, and use a heavy subject to ensure the skin is permanently submerged. Cook the skin for approximately an hour.

Once your pork skin is cooked, let it cool and make sure it is fully dry. With a sharp knife, scrape the remaining fat which has been on. The less fat you have on the skin, the more your pork rinds will double in size once air frying.

When all the pieces are fully dry, place them on the dehydrator racks and switch them on for approximately eight hours. It is good to swap the dehydrator trays from time to time to make sure your pork skin is dehydrated thoroughly and evenly.

After the pork skin is fully dehydrated, take them all and place them in a jar or a bowl. You can store directly dehydrated skin and use it whenever you would like to make fresh air fryer pork rinds. Dehydrated pork skin will stay in an airtight container for a long time.

Once ready to air fry, place a few pieces of the dehydrated pork skin into an air fryer. Remember that the pork rinds will double in size and need space to pop up correctly. Therefore, use only a handful amount of pork skin. Switch the air fryer to the highest temperature for approximately 7 to 10 minutes. The time and temperature depend really on the brand of an air fryer you have. Please read the full instructions on how to use it.
In about 10 minutes, you should have beautiful crunchy cracklings or pork rinds done in an air fryer. While still warm, sprinkle them with salt or season with your favorite spices.

title: How To Make Cold Brew Coffee Recipe
instructions: The easiest recipe, where all you need is coffee and water. Grind the coffee if you have a coffee grinder at home to have it as fresh as possible.

Prepare the mason jar or a jar you have at home. Fill it up entirely with water. Make sure you pick a jar that you can close, and it does not leak, as I do mix it from time to time within those 12-24 hours.
Add that amount of ground coffee beans to the water, depending on how strong you want your coffee to be. I usually use two spoons of ground coffee for 1 (1 pint or 16oz) Mason Jar.
Close the lid of a Mason Jar and shake it thoroughly. I still shake and remix it a few times during the day for the coffee to get more brewing.
Depending on your coffee beans, taste, and preference, store the coffee jar in the fridge for 12 to 24 hours and let the coffee steep.

Once your coffee is brewed, take a muslin cloth placed on top of the filter. Strain the coffee grounds into a clean Mason Jar. Close the lid and put it into the refrigerator. You can keep it for one week or longer and use it daily.
Once you are ready to serve, filling up the glass with Ice cubes and a bit of cold or room temperature water is best.
Pour the coffee over ice into a glass and enjoy a glass of cold brew coffee.
You can add nut milk, almond or coconut milk, or any of your preferred milk.

title: How To Freeze Blueberries
instructions: Prepare your blueberries. Freshest they are, the better they will taste after defrosting them. You can also pick baking soda and vinegar for an extra wash.

Thoroughly clean your berries and remove any stems, leaves and damaged pieces. Gently place them into a colander or strainer, wash them with cold water and fully dry them using paper towels. To go further, you can submerge them for a few minutes into cold water mixed with baking soda and vinegar to eliminate all bacteria and wax.

Place blueberries on a jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper. Keep the blueberries out in a single layer, and do not pack them in. Place your jelly roll pan in your freezer and freeze for at least two to three hours until the blueberries are entirely frozen.
Once frozen, transfer them onto a Ziploc bag or container with as much air removed as possible, then double bag them.

title: Homemade Keto Egg Noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 C or 300F
Depending on what type would you choose, prepare all of the ingredients.  Make sure they all are room temperature.
Add all of the chosen ingredients to the Magic Bullet or any of the kitchen mixers you have available and mix fully into a smooth consistency.
Prepare your baking tray and cover it with a silicone baking sheet.
Pour the whole mixture onto a baking tray.
Using your spatula or knife, gently spread the mixture evenly, making sure it is spread as thin as you can.
Place it into the oven and bake for 8 minutes.
Once the pasta sheet is baked, let it cool and gently roll into a log. Using a very sharp knife, cut the pieces into the pasta size you prefer.
Unroll and place into a bowl ready to serve.

title: Sugar Free Mini Pavlova Cake
instructions: First thing, preheat the oven and set it to a low temperature. Prepare all the ingredients you need and get your sugar-free syrup and egg whites ready.
Bring everything to a boil using a double boiler as you beat the egg whites and syrup. And as you can see in the video, I used a cooking pot with the kitchen machine's bowl.

When you start getting foamy and soft peaks form, you can stop boiling and start placing the bowl into the machine. Start whisking it using the mixer and set it from medium speed to high whisk until you get a perfect stiff peak form. While whisking, add the sugar or the sweetener of your choice. The amount will depend on how sweet you would like your meringue.

Prepare your piping bag and start transferring the mixture in. Use can use a piping tip, but you can also cut a little hole as a tip. Using the piping bag, create medium circles into the covered baking sheet with parchment paper. Open the oven to check the temperature if it was set to low. Place your pavlova in the preheated oven and let it bake for about 3 hours until they are crisp on the outside and soft on the inside. After baking, turn off the oven and let the pavlova cool completely.

There are two options when you top your pavlova cake. You can either go for whipped cream or yogurt. Assemble your cake by placing one meringue at the bottom, add the whipped cream on the top, and put a generous amount of your berries. Stack it again with another meringue and do the same until you form a beautiful pavlova cake topped with colorful berries.

title: Keto Gingerbread Village
ingredients: 3 teaspoons Gingerbread spices - an equal amount of Nutmeg (Coriander, Fennel, Anis, Cardamon, Ginger, Cinnamon)
1  Egg yolk + 3 teaspoons almond milk for top of cookies
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients together to make the gingerbread dough. If you swap vanilla protein with natural, add more sugar replacement. For spices, mix nutmeg, coriander, fennel, anis, cardamom, ginger, and cinnamon, and use three teaspoons for the mixture.
In a big mixing bowl, add all the ingredients and mix until all combined. Place into the fridge for at least an hour.
Take out the dough and roll approximately ¼ inch thick sheet. You can use protein powder or almond flour to prevent the dough from sticking together.
Using your cookie cutters, cut all the desired shapes and place them one by one on a parchment paper lined baking sheet.

Whisk together one egg yolk until smooth. You can add a few drops of almond milk. Using a brush, spread the egg wash onto each piece of cuttings.Place into the oven and bake at 170 Celsius or 325 Fahrenheit for approximately 9 minutes.
Once everything is baked, let the pieces thoroughly cool down and start assembling.

title: Steamed Bread – Keto Dumplings – Servietenknödel
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients together
Using your hand blender or a stand mixer, mix all of the eggs until fluffy.
Add all other ingredients and fully mix into one dough. This might still be a bit liquid but psyllium will slowly starts working its way into it.
Place the bowl into the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. In this time the psyllium will slowly thicken the whole dough and it will be much easier to work with later on.

Take the bowl out of the fridge and check the thickness. It has to be thick enough for you to be able to form a loaf. If you do feel, the dough is still pretty soft, sprinkle it with some additional coconut flour and mix fully in.

Place a parchment paper on the kitchen counter and sightly spray it with oil. Also spray both of your hand with oil and start shaping the loaf. Once you are happy with the shape, prepare the steamer. If you do not own the steamer, that is not a problem. Take the biggest pot you have and add a bit of water on the bottom. Let it boil and add a steaming stand. You can also use also a trivet from your instant Pot or any which fits into the pot. Add parchment paper on top of it and spray it with oil. Slowly add the bread dumpling loaf, cover the lid and let it cook or steamed for 20 minutes.
Once the loaf is steamed, gently remove the bread from the steamer and cut it into the bread-like slices using a thread or twine. Serve hot with your dish.

title: Instant Pot Best Keto Beef Stew Recipe - Goulash
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients, you are going to need.
Switch your Instant Pot on stew and let it heat up. When you finish heating up, add olive oil.
First, add all of your chopped onions and let them cook until golden brown. Once they are done, add chopped garlic and let it simmer for a while.
Cut your beef into similar sizes. Add the beef into the Pot. With a gentle and regular mixing, brown the beef and let the meat crust on the outside from all sides.
Switch the Instant Pot off. This step is crucial; otherwise, your paprika spice will burn and taste bitter.
Once the Instant Pot is switched off and the meat has cooled for about a minute, add paprika and turmeric. Mix it thoroughly, ensuring all the meat gets coated with paprika and turmeric spices.
Add the chopped mushrooms, carrot, and parsley, and mix the beef and vegetables.

Add bone broth and scrape the brown bits from the bottom of the Pot. Depending on what you are planning to cook, add the amount accordingly. Soup – 1 liter (4 Cups) of bone broth. Stew – half a liter (2 Cups) of bone broth.

Close the lid. Make sure the valve on the top is closed. Switch on the pressure and cook on high for 25 minutes. Once it's done, let the pot release the pressure gradually. Sprinkle with freshly chopped parsley or dry onions and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Keto Egg Drop Soup Recipe
instructions: Prepare a glass jar or a bowl where you will be able to whisk eggs.
Pour one to two eggs into the glass container. Using your whisk, beat the eggs until both egg whites and egg yolks are mixed together into a smooth consistency.
Using your stove, pour broth into the cooking pot and bring the soup to boil. Once the broth is boiled, set the pot over medium high heat.
Through the fork as you see in the video, slowly pour the egg into the cooking pot. The egg forms a kind of velvet egg flower look in the bowl.
After all the egg mixture has been gently poured through the fork, mix it all together and separate clumps in case any have occurred.

title: Homemade Fermented Dill Keto Pickles Recipe
instructions: First, wash all the vegetables and, most importantly, cucumbers. Spread them on a kitchen cloth to dry fully. At the same time, boil the water, into which you add salt. I usually use a ratio of 2 liters of water – 2 Tablespoons of salt. Mix the salt in until it dissolves. Switch the water off and let it cool thoroughly.
Once the brine is cooled, place it into the jug, from which it will be easier for you to pour it into the Mason jars. Add peppercorn, mustard seeds, and then cloves.
Ensure your Mason jars or any other glass containers you will use are fully washed and dry. Start with placing large dill at the bottom of each glass.
Once your carrots, parsnips, and ginger have dried, cut them into slices. Add a couple of slices inside each jar on top of the bay leaves.
Start by adding a few cucumbers into each Mason jar. On top of it, add one dry bay leave.
On the side of the glass, add one wine leave into each.
Keep layering your Mason jar with slices of veggies, ginger, dill, and cucumbers. Once the glass is filled to approximately 3/4, add one red chili pepper to each.
Finish by adding more cucumbers up to the top of the jar. Add the water mixture, which has already been infused with spices, thoroughly. Almost overflowing.
If you are using Mason jars, take the middle of the lid and cover each with the lid. Place on a kitchen table or next to the shaded window for approximately 2-3 days.
After about two days, check for the texture. Always taste the cucumber from the middle. Once you feel this is the perfect texture, close the glasses and place them into the refrigerator.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts With Bacon Recipe Skewers Style
instructions: Prepare your ingredients and fully clean Brussels sprouts. I usually take the first outer leaves out as well. You can cut the bacon or prosciutto into half if it is too wide. Get your baking tray ready and line it with parchment paper for easy clean-up. At the same time, preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius or 400 Degrees Fahrenheit.

Take a wooden skewer and assemble the skewers by threading one end of a bacon slice, then a Brussels sprout, followed by another piece of bacon, another Brussels sprout, and finally, the other end of the bacon. This creates a tasty and attractive skewer. Please look at the images or video for more clarification on the instructions.

Place the assembled skewers on the baking sheet pan covered with parchment paper. Season with salt and pepper. Roast in a hot oven for approximately 30 minutes or until the Brussels sprouts are golden brown and the bacon is crispy on the outside. Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers
instructions: Get your jumbo shrimp, red pepper, zucchini, and button mushrooms.

If you wish to infuse the shrimp with flavor, you can marinate the shrimp before grilling. Make a special sauce by mixing olive oil, lemon juice, and the outside part of the lemon (we call it lemon zest). Add the shrimp to this sauce. Let them soak up the tasty flavors.

Take your marinated big shrimp and put them onto the wooden skewers. You can also use metal skewers. Put pieces of red pepper, zucchini, and mushrooms between the shrimp. Use two to three large shrimp per skewer.

Heat a grill or grill pan and make sure it is fully hot. It will shorten the time on the grill. Put your shrimp skewers on the grill. Cook the skewers for at least 2 to 3 minutes on each side, depending on the size of the shrimp. You'll see the shrimp turn pink and not see-through anymore – that is when the shrimp are done and cooked right. Shrimp typically cook quickly, so do not leave them too long.

title: How To Make Infused Cold Brew Tea
instructions: Prepare all the dry leaves, berries, or herbs you plan to infuse. In our case, it is lemon, peppermint, lavender, and berries. Prepare a clean mason jar with the lid for each of the flavors.
Place your dry teas into the mason jar or any glass jar. Each of the herbs should have a separate jar. Make sure you have a lid for each.
Once all of the teas are in jars, add drinking water. If tap water is drinkable, it is perfect otherwise, pour bottled water.

Fully close each jar and start with the steeping, infusing, and cold brewing process. For a bit stronger concentration, keep the jars on the kitchen counter for an hour and place them into the fridge later. Keep in the refrigerator for 8 to 9 hours, best overnight.
Once your infused teas are fully cold-brewed, strain each one and store them in clean jars in the fridge for 3 to 4 days.

title: Creamy Coconut Riced Cauliflower
instructions: Prepare all ingredients together. Raw cauliflower rice can be made in a food processor from a large head of cauliflower in seconds using our steps. Coconut milk and shreds can be made at home from scratch using a regular whole coconut.

Heat your pan fully and add two tablespoons of coconut oil. Into it, add crushed garlic and let the garlic brown slightly. Lower to medium heat and add the cauliflower. Using a spatula, gently mix the oil and garlic into the rice.
Season with salt and pepper, in our case. You can add more seasonings like lime zest or fresh lime juice at this stage. Mix well.
Add the coconut milk and cook until the cauliflower rice is tender.
Once everything is ready, turn off the heat and stir in coconut shreds for an additional crunch. Serve hot with freshly chopped cilantro.

title: Cheesy Cauliflower Rice
ingredients: 2 Cups Cauliflower Rice (half of medium cauliflower)
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for easy assembly. Press your garlic cloves and shred the cheddar cheese. If you do not have your fresh riced cauliflower, I quickly explain the easy process of how to make it below in the next step. But if you are interested, I have a whole post and the recipe for making cauliflower rice in seconds with more details.

Clean and cut your head of cauliflower into smaller florets. Place them into the blender or food processor and cover them with cold water. Switch your blender to medium and see how a cauliflower turns into rice within seconds.  You have perfect cauliflower rice to use for your meals. Let it run through a sieve, and there you go. This is a great tip, especially when you have a lot of cauliflower in your kitchen.

Add the cauliflower rice to the pan and add little salt and pepper. Continue to cook the cauliflower for 3 to 4 minutes. Cauliflower rice does not need to be cooked for long. Depending on your preferred texture, 3 to 8 minutes is all you need.

Once your cauli rice is almost cooked, add cream cheese and mix it all. Cook for a few minutes. Add shredded cheddar cheese and mix it. Top up with freshly chopped herbs and serve immediately or let it cool for storage.

title: How To Cook Frozen Cauliflower Rice
instructions: First, preheat your oven to 200 Celsius or 400 Fahrenheit. Prepare all of the ingredients. Frozen rice does not need to be thawed, as the fully heated oven helps against it being mushy, and water evaporates quickly.
Take out your package of frozen cauliflower rice and try to break the big frozen clumps still in the bag. Using the back of the spatula, ensure all the rice is separated. Place onto the baking sheet.
Add the garlic cloves pressed onto the rice and add salt and pepper. Mix and spray a bit with olive oil. This will help to get a bit more crunch to the rice. Mix all thoughtfully.
Place into the fully preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Once baked, using a spatula, scrape all of the cauliflower rice from the sides of the baking sheet and mix it. The dark pieces are the crunchiest and most delicious.

title: How To Make Cauliflower Rice in Seconds
instructions: All you have to do is to prepare your cauliflower and cold water. Wash and clean our cauliflower head either using a knife or your hands. Cut the cauliflower or break it into small florets.
Place pieces of cauliflower into your Vitamix or any blender to about 3/4. Add cold water to submerge all of the florets and close the lid entirely.
Pulse the cauliflower or blend for 10 to 20 seconds, depending on the type and strength of your blender. You will see when the rice is entirely cut into small pieces, the size of rice.
Using a sieve, pour all the rice and mix it a few times to get rid of most of the water.

Store and use. Pick a few cups to cook the cauliflower for the evening, and the rest freeze. Measure the amount of rice you will freeze for the future. The best way to store it is to place the cauliflower into a zip-log bag.

title: Keto Cloud Eggs, Puffed Egg, Egg Cloud
instructions: First off, preheat your oven to 230 Celsius or 450 Fahrenheit and get all ingredients together.
Separate egg yolks from egg whites, place your egg whites into the container and whisk thoroughly until stiff peaks form.
Once your egg whites are fluffy, add bacon and cheese, and using a spatula, gently fold both of the ingredients in.

Using your spatula, start placing and shaping your egg pillows onto a parchment paper-lined baking sheet. Use a spoon to make a tiny space in the middle that we would use later on to pour the egg yolks.
Bake for 3 minutes
Take your egg pillows out of the oven and gently place egg yolks into the space in the middle of the cloud. Place into the oven once again for another three minutes.
Once your cloud eggs are baked, gently lift each of them and serve immediately using a crepes spatula.

title: Homemade Enchilada Seasoning Mix
instructions: Prepare all of the herbs and spices needed for the mix. Make sure you measure them correctly as per the recipe to get the best flavors.
For the beauty of layering, I have started with sweet paprika, garlic, black pepper, onion flakes, and chilli powder.
Continue layering cumin, brown sugar, salt, oregano, and cinnamon.
Using a small whisk or a spoon, gently but thoroughly mix all the spices into one blend. Make sure you break all the lumps, which you might encounter, especially with sweet paprika.
Once thoroughly combined and mixed, store your seasoning in a glass spice container.

title: How To Make Sausage Seasoning Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the spices and herbs you will use to mix the sausage seasoning.
If you plan to prepare this spice mix as a gift for your loved ones, pick the colors carefully for the bottle to look as vibrant as possible.
Continue with adding Rosemary, thyme, garlic, and black pepper.
As of last go Onion, dill and mustard seeds.
Using a spoon or a fork, gently mix all of the spices before filling your container for storing.

title: How To Make Everything Bagel Seasoning
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Black Cumin or Black Sesame Seeds
instructions: First, prepare all of your ingredients and a mixing bowl.
Start with placing poppy seeds into the bowl together with sesame seeds.
Add either black cumin seeds or black sesame seeds, dry garlic flakes, and onion flakes into the bowl.
Using a spoon, mix all ingredients into a perfectly tailored everything bagel seasoning recipe.

title: Italian Keto Pasta Marinara Recipe
instructions: Prepare Ingredients for Keto Pasta such as Oat Fiber, Eggs, and Cream Cheese.
Place all the ingredients into the Magic Bullet and blend fully.
Pour all onto the silicone sheet with edges.
Spread using a spatula and bake at 150C or 300F for approximately 8-10 minutes.
Once baked, shape into Ribbon or Butterfly design using Pasta Bike Roller or Wheel Roller.
Prepare Ingredients for Marinara Sauce
Cut onion and chop herbs.
Start with Browning Onion using Extra Virgin Olive Oil or Avocado Oil.
Add Herbs and Garlic and let them cook for a few minutes.
Add Canned Tomatoes, Salt & Pepper
Mix all together, close the lid and let this Sugar-Free Low-Carb Sauce cook on medium heat for 30 minutes.
Serve immediately or store in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Keto Cheese Chips With Bacon
instructions: First, preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius or 390 degrees Fahrenheit. For this recipe, all you need is two different types of cheese plus bacon. Cut bacon into tiny pieces. You do not have to pre-cook it since this bacon will be cooked in the oven while making the chips.

Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Start with emmental cheese or use shredded cheese you choose and put a pile of cheese in a round shape on the baking tray. Make sure to leave enough room in between as they will spread more.
Once you have done the first step, take the bacon bits and put a few pieces of bacon on top of each cheese dip.
The third and final step involves adding cheddar cheese to the cheese piles.
Bake in the preheated oven for approximately 7 minutes to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool.

title: How To Make Farmers Cheese Recipe
instructions: Pour all of the milk into a wide Mouth glass jar and cover it.
Store it on your kitchen cabinet or in a room temperature dry place for the next 3 days and let the milk ferment.
On a second day a fresh Cream forms on top of the milk. You can collect this and use it as a spread for your breakfast.
Third day, you will see the top of the Fresh Cream beeing a bit dry and see some cracks. That is the time to make the Farmers Cheese.

Place all of the milk into a big cooking pot and switch on the heater for low. Do not mix during or after. More you mix, less curds will form and therefore less Farmers cheese you will have at the end.
Cover it with a lid and let it cook on the lowest temperature possible for about half to 1 hour depending on how much milk you are using.
Once you see the Whey being separated from the curds, it is the time to switch the heat off and let it fully cool. Do not stir.

Once the milk is cooled, check with the end of the spatula if the curds are properly formed, by gently moving the curds away from whey. When you feel comfortable that enough curds have been formed and all of the Whey is fully separated, it is the time to move into the next step.

Very gently strain all through a strainer covered with a muslin cloth. Pour slowly and let the whey work through the strainer into the container. Let it sit and rest of the whey will slowly drip through.

title: Christmas Cheese Ball Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. With regards to cheese, any hard cheese shredded at home will work.

Place shredded cheese, crushed garlic, sour cream, salt, and pepper into a mixing bowl. Mix the whole spread until all is combined. Place the cheese ball onto the large piece of plastic wrap placed on a work surface and refrigerate for two to three hours for the mixture to harden and is firm enough to shape.

Prepare a big serving plate or cutting board, which you will use as a centerpiece. Once the cheeseball mixture is hardened, remove the cheese from the the fridge, unwrap it, and place it into the piping bag for easier assembly. Cut a hole at the end and start piping your serving plate into a tree shape. Using your spatula, you can finish the shape into a smoother look.

Start with decorating. As first use your olives for the outside of the cheese. Pick each olive and using your hands, gently push evenly onto tree mixture for the olives to hold. Continue spreading the olives all around the tree mixture.
Once you are happy with your olive spread, finish the decoration with a few steaks of rosemary branches. Sprinkle with additional dried cranberries or whole red pepper corns.

title: Roasted Creamy Keto Tomato Soup Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. Try to use as many as you can, homegrown or in good quality.

Prepare your baking sheet and line it with parchment paper. Spread your beefsteak tomatoes cut into thicker slices. Add garlic cut into halves, and onion cut into squares. I have also added a few cherry tomatoes. On top of the vegetables, add fresh thyme and sprinkle it with a bit of salt and pepper.
Sprinkle all with extra virgin olive oil. If you have avocado oil or any Italian-flavored oil, that will go perfectly together.
Place all into the oven and bake at 200 Celsius or 400 Fahrenheit for 40 minutes. You will be surprised by the beautiful smell of the kitchen while baking.
After all of the baking is done, clean all of the stems. Especially the baby tomatoes end and stems from thyme, which is pretty hard after baking. You want to have your tomato soup without those.

Once you have it all done, place all of the baked tomatoes and vegetables together with thyme into a medium size soup pot. Tomato and basil go hand in hand. So there is no way we will be ignoring that.

Adding freshly made bone or chicken broth will enhance the flavor of your homemade fresh-from-the-garden tomato and garlic soup. As mentioned above, the less bone broth you add, the thicker the soup will be. But on the other side, more carbohydrates it will have for you to consider. I usually add 2 cups of fresh bone broth we make weekly in our Instant Pot.

Use an immersion blender to mix all of it into a perfectly creamy tomato soup with fresh tomatoes. In about a minute, you will be done and ready to serve. I hope you will love this soup as much as we love it.

title: Oven Baked Pumpkin Seeds or Roasted Pepitas
instructions: With a really sharp knife cut Pumpkins in half.
Using a spoon, scoop all of the seeds and place them in a bowl.
Using your hands, clean them one by one from the pumpkin “gut”.
When you have cleaned all of the pumpkin seeds and placed them into the Mason Jar, fill it up with filtered water and add 1 Tbsp of salt.
Close the lid and mix it all together. Place it on a Kitchen table and let it soak for a minimum of 3 hours up to as long as overnight.
Preheat the oven to 150 Celsius or 300 Fahrenheits

Once your Pumpkin Seeds has been soaked, empty the jar through the sieve and sprinkle with a bit of Extra Virgin Olive oil and salt. If you do not want them salty at all, you can wash them with cold water once again and dry accordingly. Dry the remaining moisture with the paper towel.

Once dried, spread them on a baking tray covered with a Parchment paper and bake for 20 Minutes on 150 Celsius or 300 Fahreheits. After that reduce the temperature to 100 Celsius or 200 Fahrenheits and roast another 2 Hours until they are crunchy and baked.

title: Roasted Keto Pumpkin Meatballs Recipe
instructions: Heat Up the Oven to 180C or 350F
Wash and clean the inside of a Pumpkin and cut one quater of a Pumpkin into smaller squares. Place into a bowl and set aside.
The other quarter of a Pumpkin needs to be shredded with a Cheese Grater or using your kitchen machine if you wish.

In a big bow combine minced meat with all of the ingredients. Add the Grained Pumpkins into it. With a spatula or using your hands, mix the whole lot properly and using your hands to shape smaller size bowls preferably all the same size.
Once all of your balls are shaped and ready, spread them on a baking dish you have chosen. Using a parchment paper underneath is a big advantage you will realize while washing the dishes.
Once the Keto Pumpkin Meatballs are spread around the baking dish, add in between the pieces of a Pumpkin squares you have cut before.
Lightly spray the whole tray with Extra virgin Olive Oil.
In the end, add a few branches or fresh rosemary on top of the baking tray.
Bake for 40 minutes and enjoy.

title: Roasted Low Carb Pumpkin Soup Recipe
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. If you would like to also bake a pumpkin bowl for the soup, you will need 2 Pumpkins. Instructions for how to bake pumpkin bowls are above in the post. Cut Hokkaido Pumpkin into half and clean all the seeds. Cut all of the pumpkins into squares. No need to peel the skin. Clean onions and garlic and cut each into half to get the flavor out while baking.
Onto the baking sheet covered with parchment paper, spread all the cut pumpkin pieces. Add Garlic, Shallots, Turmeric, and Evo Oil.
Salt And pepper, if needed, could be added as last. Mix all of the ingredients and add a few fresh rosemary branches. Place into the oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Once everything is baked, place it into the pot, add bone broth and using a hand blender, blend all together until you get a creamy smooth consistency.

title: Quick and Easy Homemade Keto Marinara Sauce
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
First, let us start browning onions.
Once the onions are browned, add freshly chopped herbs and Garlic. Let it cook on medium heat for a minute or so, to get all of the flavors from basil, oregano as well as garlic out into the sauce.
Once done, you can add canned tomatoes or fresh ones if you prefer.
As of last, a small teaspoon of salt and pepper and mix all together.
Cover with the lid and cook on medium heat for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Keto Chicken Curry Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for easy cooking. Chop onion and crush garlic. Clean and cut the chicken breast into smaller pieces.
Start by heating your cooking pan. Add oil and let it warm. Add the onion, crushed garlic and let it caramelize. Add all the mild curry powder and let the spices roast with oil to enhance the flavor.

Add chicken pieces and let them cook thoroughly. Once the chicken is cooked, add canned coconut cream and full-fat coconut milk and let the curry simmer for 5 to 10 minutes until the sauce is thickened. Serve with freshly chopped cilantro.

title: Homemade Dehydrated Chicken
instructions: If you have frozen chicken, you can in 10 minutes pressure chicken into perfectly cooked pieces using Instant Pot or any home pressure cooker following my post.
On a cutting board, place your chicken breast and shred the chicken into smaller strips using a fork or your hand.

Place the chicken strips onto the dehydrator trays, ensuring they do not overlap. Place onto a dehydrator, close the lid, and set the temperature setting to 70 degrees Celsius or 145 degrees to 165 degrees Fahrenheit. Dehydrate for 5 to 7 hours making sure you alternate the trays filled with chicken every few hours for thorough drying.

title: Stuffed Hasselback Chicken Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients you will need for easier assembly.
Using a sharp knife, make 4-5 cutting slits into the chicken without cutting to the bottom of the chicken pieces.
Fill each slit with one piece of tomato, mozzarella, and one bigger leaf of basil. Continue until you have filled all the chicken breasts prepared.
At this point, heat the oven to 200 degrees C or 400 degrees F. Line a baking tray with parchment paper and gently place the chicken on top of the tray.
Once your chicken breasts are spread nicely over the tray, sprinkle them generously with Extra Virgin Olive Oil.
As the last step, sprinkle salt and pepper. Place chicken in the oven and bake for approximately 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked and reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees f.

title: Keto Enchiladas with Chicken
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for building enchiladas casserole. Enchilada seasoning is already inside the sauce, so there is no need to add more. Cooked chicken breasts could be shredded with a fork or pull apart using your hand. At the same time preheat oven to 350 Fahrenheit or 180 Celsius.
Start by placing one to two big scoops of keto enchilada sauce to the bottom of the skillet. Spread it all over, so the sauce in the bottom covers the base.

As you see in the video, take one tortilla, and in one corner, place a bit of shredded chicken. Layer white and cheddar shredded cheese and a dollop of sauce on top of the chicken. Roll and place filled tortillas onto the baking dish, ensuring they do not open up. Keep repeating this step until you have used all of the tortillas or the casserole is filled.
Once all of the tortillas are placed in the baking dish, pour the remaining enchilada sauce on the top middle of the tortillas. Top up with the remaining cheese and bake.

Place into the preheated oven and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit or 180 Celsius for 20 minutes. Bake in the oven until the cheese melts and the edges of the tortillas brown. Once ready to serve, sprinkle cilantro and serve with sliced avocado, sour cream, and lemon.

title: Italian Baked Chicken Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Wash and dry the chicken breasts. Chop onion and slice all of the tomatoes. Garlic is best sliced into 1/4 of an inch thick sizes. At the same time, preheat your oven to 200 degrees celsius or 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the pan. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and let it melt.
Add onion to the melted butter. Cook it until golden brown and ready. Once you feel your pan needs a bit of liquid, pour bit by bit from the bone broth into the dish.
Once the onion is browned, place the chicken breast into the skillet and cook chicken for about 7-10 minutes, turning it a few times.
Once turned, add your spices and salt and pepper. Do not forget turmeric, which I add to almost every dish. Add a bit of bone broth if you feel like the dish needs more liquid.
Cut tomatoes into halves for the them to release their own liquid and flavor once baked. Add into the skillet.
Add mini mozzarella and baby garlic and fill it with the remaining broth you have already used.
Bake the chicken for 20 minutes. Finish it up with fresh basil and serve.

title: How To Cook Frozen Chicken In Instant Pot
instructions: First of all, prepare your Instant Pot and the ingredients needed for cooking the frozen chicken. All you need is frozen chicken pieces, liquid which is either water or a broth and salt, pepper, and some spices if you would like to flavor the chicken further.
Open your instant pot and add one cup of liquid, either water or broth and place the metal rack into it.
Onto the metal rack, place your frozen chicken pieces. Make sure the chicken pieces are separated. Otherwise, it will take you much longer to cook all chicken pieces if frozen into one bulk.
After placing your frozen chicken inside the instant pot filled with liquid, close the lid and make sure the pressure valve is turned on closed.

Set the time on your instant pot depending on what type of meat or chicken pieces you will cook. Our chicken breast is set the timings for 10 minutes. Press the pressure level on high and press the pressure cooking. After your chicken has been pressurized and the timing has stopped, let the instant pot release the pressure naturally for approximately 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Keto Chicken Noodle Soup with Homemade Keto Egg Noodles
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients for the soup.

Add half a chicken, salt, and pepper into a big cooking pot. Cover it with cold water just so the chicken is submerged. Cook for a half-hour over medium heat. Once you see a tiny bit of fluffy foam on top called scum, you can discard that with either a sieve or a spoon.
In the meantime, you can clean all of your veggies and cut them so they do fit into the pot. Add all vegetables inside the soup and cook over medium heat for another 1 hour.
For the exact recipe on how to easily and quickly prepare your Keto Soup Noodles to go with this beautiful soup, I have made a separate recipe for you and check.
Using a strainer and cheesecloth, strain all soup into another pot to get the clear broth for you to use.
You can pour the clear chicken broth into the Mason Jar later on and leave only the amount you will use for serving.
Cut vegetables and cooked chicken into smaller pieces and place them into your serving plates. Pour over with boiling Broth.
Here goes your choice of noodles. You can either use our Low-Carb Soup Noodles or pick one of the suggestions mentioned above in the article.

title: Keto Protein Buns
instructions: Heat your oven at 160 Celsius or 320 Fahrenheit. At the same time, prepare a big jar where you can use a hand blender to whisk everything together. Prepare all of your ingredients.
Start with whisking together eggs and the sweetener until you get a beautiful fluffy mixture.
Add all of the wet ingredients: cream cheese, heavy cream, butter, and oil.
Whisk all together until you get a smooth consistency.
Continue adding all dry ingredients, which are unflavored protein, Xanthan gum, salt, baking soda, and baking powder.
Whisk all together once again until you get a perfectly smooth mixture for your low-carb buns.
Split the mixture into your already prepared silicone baking mold. Place into the oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Keto Buffalo Chicken Dip
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients. Wash the chicken breasts and chop the garlic. If you are using a block of cheese, grate it for easy preparation. While preparing the ingredients, start preheating your oven to 190 degrees Celsius or 375 degrees Fahrenheit.

If it is your first time using an iron skillet, thoroughly heat it before cooking. For safety, use a pot holder since the handle of this pan turns hot when you start cooking. Add oil once the pan is hot, and saute the minced garlic until it turns golden brown. Add the shredded chicken and let it simmer. Cook the chicken a bit, then add the buffalo ranch sauce and cream cheese.

After adding the buffalo sauce and cream cheese, mix until thoroughly combined, and then add the last ingredient, the shredded cheddar cheese. It is your choice whether to mix it or just put it on top and bake it, but I prefer mixing it so the cheese's flavor blends in with the dip once baked.
Once everything is mixed and combined, transfer it to the preheated oven and bake to 190C (375F) for 10 minutes. Broil to brown the top for a few minutes before taking the pan out of the oven.

title: Homemade Cheese Dip Recipe
instructions: This recipe is so simple to make, that it requires just a few steps. First of all, prepare all of your ingredients. It is best to shred your cheese at home and crush all the garlic using a garlic press.
In a big mixing bowl, add the cheese and garlic.
Add in sour cream, salt, pepper, and, if you prefer, herbs.
Using a spatula, mix all ingredients into one combined paste or dip.

title: Worcestershire Sauce Substitute
instructions: First of all, prepare all the ingredients needed. Dry ingredients are the important ones that make this sauce a great substitute for Worcestershire sauce. Prepare them and place them separately in a dry container or small bowl.
Start combining all your ingredients, starting with the wet ones. First are the vinegar and soy sauce. Add all the dry ingredients and prepare to blend.

Blend all the ingredients until well combined using a blender or magic bullet. Transfer into a glass container or cup and rest for a few minutes. Serve and use your homemade Worcestershire sauce in your next variety of dishes.

title: Keto Enchilada Sauce
instructions: First, prepare all of your ingredients. The broth could be chicken, bone, beef, etc. The best is homemade and whatever you have on hand. Tomato sauce would be best without additional ingredients to keep on track with carbs.
Start by heating your cooking pot to medium. Place oil and coconut flour in. Cook until the flour starts to brown slightly. Mix to get a smooth thick sauce.

Once you see the coconut flour turning light brown, add the seasoning and a little broth. Simmer the sauce slightly for all of the ingredients to combine. Add the tomato sauce and mix. Finish with the rest of the broth and simmer.

Last go in the vinegar and xanthan gum. Xanthan gum dissolves once the soup is cooking, but whisking it generously, helps dearly. Bring the sauce to a boil and cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until the sauce starts slightly thickening.

Once your sauce is cooked, take a hand blender and blend all of the sauce into one smooth uniformed sauce. By blending it, you will realize the red color changes and becomes much brighter. Remove the sauce from the heat, and remember the sauce thickens further.

title: Homemade Keto Breading
instructions: Start by gathering all the ingredients you'll need: breadcrumbs, smoked paprika, onion powder, granulated garlic, black pepper, and salt. This will help you stay organized and avoid missing any steps. Having everything ready will make the process quick and easy.

Add all the ingredients to a bowl. This includes breadcrumbs, smoked paprika, onion powder, granulated garlic, black pepper, and salt. Make sure to measure them out correctly to get the perfect balance of flavors.
Mix everything thoroughly. Use a whisk or spoon to ensure the spices are evenly distributed throughout the breadcrumbs. This step is key to getting that uniform taste in every bite.

title: How To Dehydrate Onions for Food Storage
instructions: Prepare your onions. Wash and clean them from all of the impurities. Slice the outer onion skin. Cut the onions into half and cut out the root or a stem. Using a sharp knife, slice the onions into thin onion streaks approximately a quarter of an inch thick.
Take each slice of onion, and separate each of the streaks using your hands.

Place fresh chopped onion pieces onto dehydrator trays making sure they are all single-layered. Depending on how many onions you plan to dehydrate, you can use that many trays. I have used one tray for one and a half of the medium size of the onion.

Place all of the dehydrator trays onto a dehydrator and close the lid. Switch to 70 degrees Celsius or 160 Fahrenheit and switch the dehydrator for 6 to 7 hours. If you are using all the trays, alternate them every 2 hours for equal dryness.

title: Italian Seasoning Substitute
instructions: Gather all the dried herbs and spices you need: rosemary, marjoram, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, dry chili flakes, oregano, and basil. Measure out the right quantities for each. Make sure your spices are fresh for the best flavor.
Take a clean mason jar or any airtight container. Carefully spoon each spice into the jar, layering them if you like a visual guide before mixing.

Using a spoon mix all of the herbs and spices. Once mixed, label your jar, and your Italian seasoning substitute is ready to use. Now you have a homemade blend that’s fresher, tastier, and free of any added fillers or preservatives.

title: Recipe For Minced Chicken
instructions: Start by cleaning the chicken thoroughly and patting it dry with a paper towel. Remove any skin, bones, or excess fat to keep the mince lean and clean. Cut the chicken into smaller chunks so it fits easily into your mincer or food processor.

Set up your meat mincer or food processor and ensure it’s clean and ready to use. Add the chicken chunks into the mincer, feeding them through gradually for an even grind. Collect the minced chicken in a bowl and fluff it with a fork to loosen any clumps.

title: Master Roasted Vegetables Like a Pro
instructions: Start by preheating your oven. A hot oven is essential to create crispy edges and perfectly cooked interiors. You can lower the temperature slightly for delicate vegetables to avoid burning them.

Wash your vegetables thoroughly and pat them dry to remove excess moisture. Cut them into uniform pieces to make sure they are evenly cooking—smaller pieces for harder veggies and slightly larger ones for softer vegetables. Proper preparation sets the stage for consistent roasting results.

Sprinkle with your favorite seasonings. Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet. Leave space between each piece to allow for proper air circulation, which helps them roast instead of steam.
Place the baking sheet in your preheated oven. Halfway through, use tongs or a spatula to flip them. Serve your roasted vegetables hot as a side dish, salad topping, or main course component.

title: Christmas Tree Cupcakes Recipe
ingredients: Optional: Small Strawberries or any other berries
instructions: First of, prepare your cupcakes. I have the easy cupcakes and chocolate cupcakes full recipes on the site. Pick the one you prefer. Once you bake them, place them on a cooling rack to cool completely for the frosting to hold.

Using a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, whisk together cream cheese with sweetener in a medium bowl scraping the side of a bowl as needed. Once you have a smooth frosting, add green color and mix until you are happy with the hue. Place your frosting into the piping bag fitted with a small star end tip. Close on top and place into your fridge for an hour for the frosting to harden.

Take your frosting from the refrigerator. Pipe a tiny dot in the middle of a cooled cupcake and attach your strawberry onto the cupcake. Start piping small star dots from the base of the cupcake around your strawberry. Continue to pipe the frosting in a circular motion as a second layer above it. Keep piping until a whole strawberry is covered, and you create a tree. Take out your sprinkles and beautify the tree.

title: Activated Almonds or Soaked Almonds Snack
instructions: Prepare your nuts, in our case, raw almonds. At the same time, get a bowl with water ready.
First of wash your nuts. Place them into a small bowl and add water. Place it onto your kitchen table and let it sit for 24 hours or overnight.
Next day, take the bowl and wash the nuts once again. Tap dry all of your nuts and spread them onto dehydrator trays. Dry at a low temperature for 7 to 8 hours until fully dry.
Once all of your almonds are completely dry, you can either use them as a snack or store them in a glass container for later.

title: How To Make Natural Whey Protein Drink
instructions: Pour your un-pasterised milk into a glass container which could be left on the Kitchen Cabinet.
Cover the top and leave it for 3-4 days.
On the third day, you should see the consistency changing and the milk will curdle.
Cook it on a low temperature for about half hour until you see the curds separating from the whey.
To check if the process is done, take the end of a spatula and gently try to move the curds away from Whey. If you see them fully separated, it is time to switch the cooking process.
At this time let everything cool down. The curds will harden a bit and therefore you will be able to get more whey.
Using your strainer covered with a muslin cloth, gently strain the curds from Whey.

title: Keto Bone Broth Recipe in an Instant Pot
instructions: Get all your bones ready, clean all the veggies, and cut them into bigger pieces.
Switch the Instant Pot on Sauté, add olive oil and bones and sauté the bones from all the sites.
Add vegetables, vinegar, herbs, salt, and pepper. Pour water until all is covered. Close the lid and make sure the pressure valve is set to close.
Press to soup and set it for 2 hours on high pressure. After 2 hours, leave the Pot to release naturally for best results.
After the soup is cool to handle, strain it through a Muslin cloth to get the clearest soup possible.
Use it immediately or separate it into Mason jars for later usage.

title: Homemade Fruit Roll Ups Fruit Leather Recipe
ingredients: 2 Cups Berries or fruit of your choice
instructions: Wash and clean the strawberries or berries you are going to use. You can mix them, use separate types or decorate them as in my video.
Add strawberries into the magic bullet cup or a blender and puree the fruit thoroughly.
If you are using a dehydrator with a round shape, you might need a plastic insert that goes inside each of the dehydrator layers.
Pour the fruit mixture onto the plastic or parchment paper and use an offset spatula to help spread the puree into quarter inch thick layer.
If you want to make it more decorative, look at the video, where I have used a bit of blueberry mixture. I filled that mixture into a syringe and gently pressed small dots on a strawberry layer.

This step is optional, but I have added this as well, in case you want to go more into decorating. As you see in the video, I have further made little star-like streaks out of the dots with a thin metal stick.

Once all the layers are poured and spread, place them one by one on top of each other onto your dehydrator. Switch the dehydrator on for approximately eight hours. Swapping the layers from time to time is advisable so each rack will get fully dehydrated.

When your fruit roll-ups are fully dehydrated, let them cool completely. To check, touch each fruit roll with your bare hands and ensure they are no longer sticky. Gently peel the fruit leather from either plastic, parchment paper or a silicone sheet.
The final step is to pre-cut your fruit skin. You can either roll the whole sheet and, using your scissors, cut it into the desired size.

title: How To Make Cranberry Powder from Dehydrated Craisins
instructions: Prepare your cranberries. You can either use store-bought dried cranberries or make your own craisins as mentioned above.

Transfer your DIY craisins to the blender or food processor. You can also use a coffee grinder since it makes fine powder, but make sure your blender or grinder is completely dry so the powder won't clump. Blend on the lowest setting until you get a fine, dusty fruit powder from the cranberries.
Gently open the lid, and they are ready to be stored. Be careful when opening the lid because it is dusty. You can use a small spoon to transfer the powder to a container.

title: Easy Cheesy Keto Brussel Sprouts Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit

Clean your brussels sprouts by cutting the end of the buts and peeling the outer layer of the leaves. Wash and place into the boiling pot of water for approximately five minutes and immediately place them into the iced water.
In the meantime, add eggs into a mixing bowl and whisk them properly. At the same time, add salt and pepper.
Once your eggs are whisked, continue adding sour cream and mix thoroughly
As the last ingredient, add your grated cheese and ensure the whole mixture is smooth.
Depending on the size of your casserole dish, spread the brussels sprouts evenly around.
Gently pour the mixture onto the brussels sprouts covering them all.
Place into the oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes.
After your Keto casserole has been baked, take it out of the oven. Spread the rest of the grated cheese on top.
Place again into the oven and bake for 10 minutes until the cheese becomes golden brown.

title: Easy Keto Peanut Butter Cheesecake Instant Pot
instructions: As we only have 4 Ingredients in the basic Keto Cheesecake, it is easy to put them together. If you plan to make the crunchy topping, add brown sweetener and a bowl of peanuts.
Place all 4 ingredients into the bowl and mix: peanut butter, yogurt, sweetener, and eggs.

Pour the whole mixture into the Springform pan (that fits into your Instant Pot) lined with parchment paper from the sides as well. This will help in cleaning afterward. As you see in the picture, I have made a base handle or a thick sheet from the aluminum foil (check video) to place the spring form into the instant pot easily and especially take out once everything is done and hot. Cover the top of the springform pan with aluminum and ensure no air can come in or out. This will prevent your peanut butter cheesecake from becoming too dry and cracking.

Place your trivet into the Instant pot and add one cup of water. Gently place your spring form with an aluminum holder into the Instant Pot. Cover the lid and set your Instant Pot to pressure cook for 25 minutes on high pressure. Once done, take out of the Instant Pot, let it cool and place into the refrigerator to set fully, best overnight.

You can prepare the crunchy topping crumbles for your cheesecake if you would like. This is optional, and you can skip this step. Roast unsalted peanuts on the stove. Add Brown Sugar sweetener and let it melt. Mix together and pour onto the parchment paper. Once cooled, break into small pieces to make peanut crumbles.
Once you are ready to serve, take your cheesecake out of the fridge, and sprinkle it with peanut crumble and dollops of yogurt. Open the spring form and serve.

title: Keto Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Before you start, gather all your ingredients and tools. Ensure you have your minced chicken, eggs, breading mix, a bowl, and a baking tray ready. This will make the process smooth and quick.

In one bowl, beat your eggs for the wet coating, and in another, place your breading mix for the dry coating. You’ll mix the chicken nuggets first into the egg, then into the breading to get a nice even layer. Make sure the breading fully coats each nugget.

Combine your minced chicken with the beaten egg in a bowl, mixing until well incorporated. This will help bind the chicken and make sure the breading sticks better. It’s the base of your nugget mixture, so make sure it’s evenly mixed.

Shape the chicken mixture into small nugget-sized portions and place them on a lined baking tray. Bake in the preheated oven at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 10 minutes, then flip and bake for another 10 minutes for even cooking. You’ll have perfectly crispy, golden nuggets ready in no time.
